title: the owed pins and the deity site
audit_comment: THE OWED PINS AND THE DEITY SITE - four feeds in one round (Curtiss's all-four pick). (1) The lance printed cells the R780 boundary owed: the lengths 10/12/14 feet and the 1-foot space-required cell pin as data (the compilation print the R189 duty already trusts; the R780 engine sense stands - no caller reads a length yet). (2) The spear 6..8 spread ends its contract-side stay: weaponspeed.h gains the length-keyed companion to the R158 range helper - 5 feet and under reads 6, 13 and over reads 8, the middle keeps the default 7. (3) The deity layer site lands: the R405 no-site contract is STRUCK - the bridge copies every Appendix S stat block onto a monster-side Actor (the printed hp and AC whole, the halves halved, the damage span floored), the stat-block charge closes with it, and a live site block in regtest walks all 23 blocks through the bridge (the five charts stay their own seam). (4) The DMG p.66 closing bar reads the fronts: a mounted front in round one is a closing charge, and the print exempts the charging round from the tie order (case 1) and the extra-attack window (case 2) - the monster side never lance-charges (the R779 boundary); its mounted round one reads as the closing bar alone. Honest boundaries: the deity attack matrix stays on the monster HD convention (the bridge pins hitDice 1.0), the spawn path stays contract-side, the R406 hole cells ride their sentinels verbatim (the attack holes floor to one routine on the bridge and the AC hole 99 round-trips whole), and the site block printf carries no census marker (the census counts this audit alone)

banner.title: THE OWED PINS AND THE DEITY SITE - four feeds in one round: the lance lengths, the spear spread, the Appendix S bridge, the closing bar
banner.provenance: R780 left the lance printed lengths contract-side and the R158 spear at its default 7; R405 left the deity pins site-less and the Appendix S charge open; R781 left the DMG p.66 fold without its charging bar. R782 closes all four. The lance cells (10/12/14 feet, 1 foot of space required) pin as data from the compilation print the R189 speed-verify duty already trusts. The spear spread gains its length key (the 6/7/8 cells the R158 range helper always implied). The deity site lands as a bridge: every Appendix S stat block becomes a monster-side Actor - the printed hp and AC whole, the attack halves halved, the damage span on the dice plus the floor - and a live regtest site block walks all 23 blocks through it (the R405 layer contract flips with its audit; the five charts stay their own seam). And the closing bar: a mounted front in round one is a closing charge, exempt from the case-1 tie order and the case-2 extra window (speedFactorApplies reads it at last); the monster side never lance-charges - the R779 boundary stands - its mounted round one reads as the closing bar alone. Honest boundaries: the deity matrix stays on the monster HD convention (hitDice 1.0), the spawn path stays contract-side, no engine caller reads a lance length yet, and the R780 engine sense stands
banner.sentinel: Zero new book pages: the lance cells ride the compilation print the R189 duty trusts, the spear spread rides the R158 print already honored, the deity blocks ride the R406 stat-block pins, and the closing bar rides DMG p.66 already honored in weaponspeed.h
